name: Seismology
summary: The theory and observation of seismic waves and earthquake sources, and their use to image the Earth.

topics.name: Elasticity and the seismic wave equation
Body waves (P and S) and surface waves (Rayleigh and Love)
Ray theory, travel-time curves and Earth models (PREM)
Seismometers, seismic networks and data processing
Earthquake location and magnitude scales; seismic moment
Earthquake source physics: rupture dynamics and scaling
Free oscillations (normal modes) of the Earth
